classic_clipping.scope: Classic EMF region combination, meta region and offset mask lifecycle adaptation

boolean_raster.scope: Classic GDI ROP2 (16 functions) and ROP3 (256 truth tables); WMF DIBBITBLT/DIBSTRETCHBLT/STRETCHDIB/PATBLT and EMF BITBLT/STRETCHBLT/STRETCHDIBITS, bounded native destination/source/pattern/coverage composition

classic_drawing_state.implementation: Original TurtleGit stock object and logical palette playback (GPL-2.0-or-later)
classic_drawing_state.scope: Classic stock DC_BRUSH/DC_PEN defaults, recorded explicit color replacements, saved object selection, and logical palette color references across vector/raster consumers
classic_drawing_state.default_logical_palette_profile: Windows common display 20-color logical palette; a deterministic macOS playback profile, not an arbitrary printer or physical device palette

high_depth_bitmaps.implementation: Original TurtleGit raw high-depth bitmap adapter; no Wine functions copied
high_depth_bitmaps.profile: Little-endian B,G,R,[A] WORD high-byte display projection; premultiplied samples quantize before the existing premultiplied PNG pipeline; zero alpha clears premultiplied RGB; raw DWORD-aligned stride
high_depth_bitmaps.limits: 8-bit macOS display profile, not Windows GDI+ 13-bit LockBits/HDR/color-management identity

emf_plus_source_copy.scope: Ordered individual EMF+ paints with independent geometry, SourceCopy/SourceOver saved graphics state and Clear replacement
emf_plus_source_copy.display_profile: Premultiplied eight-bit sRGB source replacement; source already contains edge/clip coverage; destination retained outside independent coverage
emf_plus_source_copy.limits: Existing raster checkpoint authority, cumulative pixel/work/markup/memory and output budgets remain enforced

path_gradient_painting.scope: EMF+ polygon/canonical-ellipse path brushes, surrounding colors, captured centers, focus scales and gamma through shared fill/pen/glyph/clip/SourceCopy consumers; source-backed linear gamma and associated-alpha interpolation
path_gradient_painting.aliased_pen_coverage: Conversion-scoped exact native stroke-outline receipts and binary device-lattice masks; geometric coverage remains independent of brush alpha.

emf_natural_canvas.implementation: Original TurtleGit inclusive EMF canvas extent; record/device coordinates are not rescaled
emf_natural_canvas.profile: Round the physical frame extent in device pixels, then include the final edge pixel; leave WMF extents unchanged
emf_natural_canvas.scope: Four original file-consumer controls plus four independent fractional-frame probes; not an exhaustive survey of malformed headers or printer devices
